text:
marta: Quick UX review — p95 axis contrast + sampling presets. Screenshot attached: https://figma.com/... (it's a quick mock)

alina: Thanks. Main problems I see: labels on the left collapse visually into the heatmap when density is high. Contrast is below WCAG when compacted.

sam: Agree. Also the sampler dropdown overlaps the timepicker dropdown on narrow widths. Repro: set width=980, open sampler then timepicker.

vic: Two microcopy items: the preset 'Compact (fast)' doesn't explain tradeoffs. Maybe 'Compact (lower cost, higher sampling)'?

marta: Proposed fixes:
- increase axis text color to `--color-text-strong`
- add 8px horizontal gap between axis and heatmap
- change preset copy to highlight latency/cost tradeoffs
- sampler: pin below timepicker on <= 1000px

alina: Accessibility check — with `--color-text-strong` p95 label passes 4.5:1 at 14px, good. Also we need visible focus for preset chips (keyboard users)

sam: For the sampler affordance, +1 to pinning. Also suggest shortcut key `k` to jump focus to sampler and `t` to open timepicker.

ux-bot: Figma update: https://figma.com/file/abc123 — comments added on axis tokens and preset copy. I attached a quick CSS snippet for the gap and focus ring.

```
:root {
  --axis-gap: 8px;
  --axis-color: var(--color-text-strong);
}
.preset-chip:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px }
```

vic: One more: when p95 card is collapsed we should show a mini-sparkline + 'p95' label to keep context. Current collapse loses metric clarity.

marta: Good call. Action items:
- Alina: update tokens + accessibility test (due EOD)
- Sam: sampler/timepicker pin + keyboard shortcuts PR (due Thu)
- Vic: write copy variants for presets (3 options)
- Marta: update figma and follow up on collapsed p95 microview

alina: I'll drop notes in the design doc and ping infra for color token rollout.

sam: I'll prototype the keyboard shortcut behavior and post short gif here when ready :eyes: 

marta: Thanks team :thumbsup:
